entity.summary: Global centralized cryptocurrency exchange founded by Haipo Yang on December 24, 2017, now in an orderly wind-down after announcing that the exchange platform will cease operations on December 22, 2026.
entity.notes: CoinEx announced an orderly cessation process on September 15, 2026. New registrations and new non-spot subscriptions/orders have ceased, futures are reduce-only, non-spot services are scheduled to cease on September 22, spot trading and CoinEx Smart Chain / OneSwap on September 29, and the exchange platform after the withdrawal window on December 22. HEI keeps death_date null and status limited until terminal cessation is confirmed. CoinEx Wallet and CoinEx Vault are explicitly outside the exchange wind-down.

events.title: CoinEx was founded
events.description: Haipo Yang founded CoinEx on December 24, 2017 as a centralized cryptocurrency exchange.
events.notes: The exact founding date is stated by CoinEx's official history.

events.title: CoinEx agreed to New York ban and monetary settlement
events.description: CoinEx agreed to pay about $1.8 million and be banned from operating in New York to resolve a lawsuit brought by the New York Attorney General alleging illegal unregistered operations in the state.
events.notes: This was a jurisdiction-specific regulatory action and did not mark CoinEx as dead globally.

events.title: CoinEx hot-wallet private key was compromised
events.description: CoinEx detected anomalous withdrawals from hot wallets on September 12, 2023 and later stated that the incident was caused by leakage of a hot-wallet private key.
events.notes: CoinEx suspended deposits and withdrawals during wallet reconstruction and began restoring services on September 21, 2023.

events.title: CoinEx announced an orderly wind-down
events.description: CoinEx announced that it would cease operations through a staged wind-down: new registrations and new non-spot subscriptions/orders stopped on September 15, non-spot services were scheduled to cease on September 22, spot trading and CoinEx Smart Chain / OneSwap on September 29, and the exchange platform after the withdrawal window on December 22, 2026.
events.notes: This records the announced wind-down and present limited state, not a completed shutdown. death_date remains null until the terminal cessation is confirmed.
